title: Why the real AI apocalypse is already here – Stateside with Kai and Carter
byline: Rachel Humphreys, Johana Bhuiyan, Ivan Kuraev, Kai Wright, Tiara Chiaramonte, Jonathan Menjivar, Carter Sherman
excerpt: A former Anthropic researcher’s apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence has led to a global panic that the technology might be the end of us all. But is this response a distraction from the more immediate problems AI is already causing?
content_html: A former Anthropic researcher’s apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence has led to a global panic that the technology might be the end of us all. At an event in Washington today to warn about the dangers of AI, US senator Bernie Sanders said that Congress has been ‘asleep at the wheel'. Oddly, Steve Bannon appeared at the same event. But is this response a distraction from the more immediate problems AI is already causing? Kai Wright and Carter Sherman are joined by Guardian tech reporter Johana Bhuyian to put this moment in context, and she explains why we should be cynical about industry calls for regulation
